hero.headline: Davis is built for what’s next. Let’s make that story *visible.*
hero.lead: Your new economic development plan names the opportunity clearly: position Davis as a premier destination for innovation, entrepreneurship, and high-quality living. Hallpass can help turn that ambition into a story people see, remember, and act on.
